title: Rovo Cloud
summary: Use Atlassian context and configured automation actions for bounded tasks.

sections.label: Verified write behavior
sections.text: Current Use agent documentation supports direct writes via “Let this agent take actions”, off by default. It also supports agentResponse passed to explicit downstream actions.

sections.label: Initial design
sections.text: Use a specified Jira or Confluence action after the analysis when you want a tightly defined mutation. Inspect action traces and actor identity.

sections.label: Reasoning and cost
sections.text: Rovo offers Quick and Think deeper tiers; available selections and limits vary. Match the tier to the task and measure credit consumption. Rovo Cloud is the relevant product here, not Rovo CLI.

confidence: High for docs; unknown for tenant configuration

catalog.applicability: Use this Rovo Cloud example when a bounded task needs Atlassian context and a configured Jira or Confluence action after the analysis. Direct writes are off by default, so inspect action traces, the actor identity and credit consumption for the chosen reasoning tier.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
